Ia kitapo segiminrang- oni badiaba biaprang ba saniba bimung ba saniba janggi tangani baksa apsan nangrimani dongo-de,'uan maibakai' ong'gakanisan ong'aigen. Ia golpo bi'sako seanio anga, Mr.

Icyan Marak Author --- Page 7 --- Part I Na'batmaangni song Chigitchakgreara A'chik songni biap damsao, a'brini a'patal dakao ong'achim. Songni salgrochipak ua jolni chubatgipa a'kimbrirang donga chim.
Salgipengchi onbatgipa a'brirang aro saliramchi chiringni a'kawerangko niwatachim. Wachi somoiode chel'achi Songduko rikrak rikrak ching'pile nikatachim.

Songade dongansenga, maina balwa balsranga aro chiba a'rak wachi tipjachim. A'brirango misi sarangde mintokahachim, aro bilsi soke cha'na chu'onggijagiparangba da'ode okumu chakna- de nangjaengahachim.

Salsao mipring cha'mane, nokgilo dengdale, ma'gipa- chi janggiltike, "Nokmani a'bachi angaba a'jak re'ang- nane, ama," Na'bat ma'gipao bi'aha. "A'ba gamnama, pante am'nama," manenga gnang ma'gipa nokningoni aganataha, “noktangon kam dongja inagita".
“Sal somoiara, bilsiara chu'ongaha, pante am'oba mai ringjoljole pagipa jikgipako kajia am' ataha. "Im, nang'paan watatode namaia.
Re'ang, re'ang.." demechikna chakani gimin ma'gipa segipako ka'onange namnikbregijasa watataha. Na'batpade jikgipani namnikgijana an'tangsa ka'- dingsike dongaiaha.

Nabat bik nokchi napbae an'tangni koping tangsim, nokgilo pote dona gitchi, atte aro man'ode am'bol sot- bajolna ine kokchengko ra'c re'angaha. Na'bat baksa ua --- Page 8 --- songni adita pante me'trarang Nokmani a'bako gamna re'angaha.

Sal jatchinangnango mikgitchak pegitchak jamatalo jinma neg' taktokengachim. A'gital pante saksa jamatalo rosoe panteskarangming golpo ka'e ka'dinge nomilrangko kajia ka'e ropaaha. Ia pantea songadamo donggipa panterangna bate kraa gitan rongtalbatachim aro agana bewalrangba nambata- chim.
Uara mande sakchigrike, dal'ang-bolchaang daka- chim. A'chik pante ma'ate be'en ma'kete ja'pate jakpatte dal'dalachim.
Knikoba kraa gitan kan'dike roka aro mikkangchipak adita rikkenachim. Ua mandeska baksa meliningna man'gipa golpo ka'o katta man'gipa, tol'e roe ka'dingatna changgipa ong'achim.
Songskani mande ong'ani gimin, wanno re'c doe, panteskarangde uko uitokachim. Uamang tol'grike etalgrike rorongachim.
Uni songara Chigitachakgreoni kanta gittam ja'achi re'na nangachim. "Mamasongde bo'na man'ane", pante saksa agital ku'jaenggen, biade an'ching Nokmani grigipasa.
Bimung- kode knaenggnok. Ianba Kaling, songde awa nalsaon, Pal'wanggopara.
Bisong songode pante rogipade biasan- jok." "Oc, angade gitchajok" ine Kaling ka'dingatna aganaha. Jinma ka'dinggrimaha.
"Bikoara an'ching Nokmaan kangjokkonba," saksa aganaha. "Aiao, Minjakde chondugaskaenga da'nang," sakgipin aganskaaha.
"Uaba uaba ong'ja, guasutangkon grongkuja," nomil- rangchi niate Kaling miksichipataha. la kattarangna Na' batde mikkang gitchakaha; Kaling mikketchichi uko nikengachim.
Ua somoionin Na'batde --- Page 9 --- Kaliugko on'timintiba nichakjaha. Uni aganarangna aro tangde aganjaha.

Kalingde Na'batni il'leng siksakako, rama re'ako aro ka'dingako gisep gisep srik srik nie roaha. Sal ka' sinahao me'trarangde a'ba a'seo am'bol sotrik- aha. Panteskarang baksa Kalingba a'ba ramako songona re'joljole golpororobaengachim.
"Koping tangsim kagipara sawasa ?" Kaling sing'- aha. "Mai-ang nogipaanba uara, mosa, ma'deni bi'- sasaba," saksagipa pante aganaha.
"Ba.....mama, uijok. Agandapna nangjajok,"' sakgipin Kalingko tataha.
"Ong'ja na'a, ong'ja na'a.....uina skesa singengaba, mai cng'pajokna," Kalingde ia kattarangkosan man'- aiaha. "Oe, chingaba uijok na'a, Da aganbojok," saksa tap agandapaha.
"Jajrengnabe mosa, anga ademanguade agane on'- aigen". Indake pante skarangni sitap gitap aganoara Kalingde jrip doagsrangaiaha.
Babilsi noksamo am' bol ongalako knae Na'batni ma'- gipa pagipa rang'san jrip dakaha. "Au miksue mi cha'galgalbo," ma'gipa Na'batke aganataha.

Pangnade ma.gipara skatang kusitang mi cha'- ako niaia, ua salde maina an'tangko indake agana ine chanchijoljole, chigachi auna basing te'sa ra'jole re'- angaha. Chiring dilgni dongoba dilsakosan songni manderang ringna aro auna jakkalachim.

Ua chigao salode bi'- sarangni chetchat chetchat graparangko, atamchibara me'chikrangni ku'rang aro sal napangabaode me'asa- rangni ku'simita, ka'dinga are jikjakarangko knaronga- chim. --- Page 10 --- Dilsagipa chiringde dal'batkaloba chi mesenga, na'tik ang'keba dongja aro rong'terangoba gitchak gitchak dake chirinik ma'bakachim.
Ia chiringkoa songo napna skang ga'batna nangachim, aro ia chiringchian ua songko Chigit- chakgreine mingachim. Salde napmanahachim.

Panterangni aumiksuna re'- baako grongdikna kene Na'bat skelbakel aubroke re'- bapilengachim. Ua ramao pante jinmako jikjakroroe re'- baako grongbebealha. Ua nichaogija ramako nionari re'- oba ja'gitotnianpilengachim.
Kalingba uno dongpaa ine ua uina man'achim. Uamang Na'batna jrip jrip rama wataha, indiba uamangko janggilatsrapgijan saoba gam'c ahamataha.
Unsalode maina an'tangko kal'akataha Na'- batde-gisiktango tikkit tikkit chanchiaha. Ma'a paa senggaang meatam cha'e barandao neng'- taksoengachim.
Ma'gipa wa'sco asonge me'rakku bikapo sada dol'e ringengachim. Pagipara morao ja'a ra.dopile asongesa, pakmao dan'dane suk ong'e mola opengachim.
Na'bat gansre chinsremane mi cha'na babilsichi napang- aha. Chudapo wa'al so'chimitako spoe ua chakki so'aha.

Salgimiko ong'a a'selrang, uamangni ka'dinge agane rogipa kattarang aro Kalingni mikkang bimang pil'taitai uni gisiko nabaengachim. Mepaltangko cha'e nioba ku'sa ku'gnikon okkanikaiaha; achak menggonasa suale on'- ataiaha.
Maikaisa okkachangaha, Na'batsa uiaijok. Nokona gadobaahaon ma'gipa Na'batko barandaona okamataha.
Ma'gipa pagipani gisepo sawa mai kattako aganchenggen chanchion man'jaengachim. Maina ding- tangmancha okamenga, Na'batde kenaba kenpilengachim.
Da'ode andalaha, noksul songsul adita chel'tangesa nok rike dongani gimin banoba bachibasa wa'alko nikataia- chim. Mande jikjakarangko aro gisep gisep bi'sa grapa- rangkoba knaatkucngachim.
Balwa balsrike. ka'sinan baksa jong'dol sarao mikoakosa knabataiahachim.
